context: Implement hoisting for columns that are constant because of the route's query shape, computed once from the route contract rather than from the rendered rows. State the hoisted value in the caption. Sparse and filter-constant columns are explicitly out of scope; add a test asserting a sparse column survives.
description:
Columns whose value is constant by construction of a route spend table width repeating themselves. On the Platforms page 'Metric contract' repeats the same string across most rows, wrapping to two lines and roughly doubling row height.

Two corrections established by review that bound this item tightly:
1. Dynamic removal - hiding a column because it happens to be constant for the CURRENT filter or page - causes columns to pop in and out, shifting layout, churning aria-colindex, and breaking e2e selectors. Only route-constant columns may be hoisted.
2. Sparse is not empty. Platforms' 'Power score' is populated for 2 of 16 DuckDB rows, not 0. A sparse column must never be removed.

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight

anti_patterns.dont: hide a column because it is constant for the current filter or page
anti_patterns.why: dynamic removal shifts layout and breaks screen-reader column indexing

anti_patterns.dont: treat a sparse column as empty
anti_patterns.why: Platforms' power score is populated for 2 of 16 rows; removing it would drop real data

preserves.behavior: aria-colindex/aria-colcount stability across filters and pages
